policy_note:
Default policy is 90% line coverage per source file. Coverage runs use `--test-threads=1` (see Makefile) to serialise env-sensitive tests across lib + integration binaries. Session 6 close (2026-05-16): TOTAL 97.28%, 59/59 files at ≥90%, zero debt baselines. The static `CALL_COUNT < 3` guard in `decode/diag.rs::log_decode_entry` is exercised via `tests/test_decode_diag.rs`, a dedicated integration binary that gets a fresh process where the counter starts at 0. 2026-05-19 compute-refactor regression: branch added ~344 LOC of W10 state-bridge wrappers (`decode_token_with_state_dump_*_fn`, `coarse_*_with_state_masked`) to `decode/mod.rs` and `trait_impl/mod.rs` without proportional Metal-side test coverage. 2026-05-20 partial recovery: 4 new tests in `tests/test_metal_decode_synthetic.rs` exercise the masked-fn surface under `StateDumpMask::{Full, HOnly, None}` plus the unmasked wrapper — decode/mod.rs back to 93.36%, no longer needs a debt baseline. trait_impl/mod.rs's `hybrid_decode_attention_layer` body still uncovered: the synthetic Q4_K fixture null-ptrs deep in `decode_attention_layer` (needs a real vindex with attn_kquant data installed, not just raw Q4_K bytes). Keep its baseline at 87 and clear it when the hybrid pipeline gets a proper end-to-end synthetic vindex fixture in this crate.

2026-08-23: TOTAL cleared the 96% floor (96.21%) once PR #281's trait_impl/backend/diag suites landed alongside the sliced-matvec and fused-residual gates. Two files are recorded as explicit debt rather than left to fail the gate, because a red check nobody can action is a check people learn to ignore: lowering/stack.rs (86.63%) and moe_gpu_route/encode.rs (80.17%). Neither is new and neither was touched by that work. What they need is not more unit tests but a fixture that drives a full routed layer end to end — encode.rs's uncovered lines are the descriptor/bias/combine encode arms that only fire with a real expert bank in registered memory, and stack.rs's are the hybrid-FFN and layer-scalar composition arms. Raise these numbers when that fixture exists; do not paper over them by asserting on encode-side state that a wrong kernel would also produce.

2026-08-27: three files are recorded as debt because the CI RUNNER cannot execute their code, not because they lack tests. The job is `runs-on: macos-14`; `MTLResidencySet` is macOS 15+, so `ResidencySet::new()` returns None there and every lifecycle test in buffers/residency/tests.rs takes its `let Some(..) else { return }` arm and passes having run nothing. buffers/regions.rs::seal_residency calls the same constructor. lowering/profile.rs::StageProfiler::try_new refuses for the reason its own comment gives - the macos-14 paravirtualized GPU returns a nil `counterSets` array - so no StageProfiler path is reachable either.

Measured on macOS 15.7.4 with a real GPU, the same commit gives residency.rs 92.98%, regions.rs 95.24%, profile.rs 97.25%, TOTAL 96.34%. Every other file matches the runner to the decimal (checked against stages/attention.rs, stages/ffn.rs, trait_impl/decode.rs, trait_impl/matmul.rs, trait_impl/mod.rs, shaders/mxfp4_grouped_experts.rs), and the arithmetic closes: the runner misses 159 more lines than local, which is exactly 9 + 40 + 110 across these three.

So do NOT write tests against these numbers - the lines are unreachable on the runner, and a test that appears to cover them would be asserting on the degraded path. Raise them when the job moves to a runner with macOS 15+ and a GPU that samples counters at stage boundaries; residency.rs and regions.rs should recover on the OS bump alone, profile.rs needs the counter-sampling capability. The TOTAL floor drops to 95.5 for the same reason and returns to 96 with them.

2026-09-06 (K3-ACT-1): moe_gpu_route/encode.rs 80.17 -> 78.16, baseline 80 -> 78. The rung added a third arm to the routed activation dispatch (Kimi-K3's SiTU-GLU) plus its admission guard. Those lines are COVERED — `llvm-cov report --json` gives the SiTU arm execution count 8 and the admission guard 21-25, and no added line appears in `--show-missing-lines` — and the file gained an end-to-end witness driving all three routed entry points (`gpu_route_layer_serves_situ_glu_on_every_routed_arm`) plus an admission refusal arm. The percentage still falls because the file's line accounting is not per-source-line: 15 of the 107 'missed' lines are lines covered in one instantiation and missed in another (92 unique missing line numbers against 107 missed), up from 2 at the baseline. Adding 16 lines to a function counted this way moved `covered` by only 3. Do NOT chase this with tests asserting on encode-side state — the note above already warns against that, and the code the number is complaining about is the same MXFP4 fused gate/up and fused down+combine arms it has always been complaining about, which need a real expert bank in registered memory. Measured on macOS with a real GPU; the baseline arm at 1e57b6d1 measures 80.17 on the same machine, so this is a delta, not drift.
